text: Prefer getByRole / getByLabel over CSS selectors so tests track user-visible UI.
Assert state before screenshots — a blank failure page can still produce a green PNG.
Use webServer + baseURL in config so CI and local share one entry point.
trace: on-first-retry beats always-on traces for signal vs artifact bloat.
Keep e2e workers low when tests share one server or database — races fake flakes.
Sandbox HOME / state dirs in e2e so a suite never wipes a developer machine.
Upload HTML report + traces only on failure — cheap when green, useful when red.
Smoke after every meaningful deploy: one happy path beats zero confidence.
Smoke should fail loud and finish fast — under a few minutes or it will be skipped.
Icon-only buttons need an accessible name (aria-label) or they announce as “button”.
Use focus-visible rings — outline:none without a replacement breaks keyboard users.
Heading levels should increase by one; skip h2→h4 and axe will flag it.
WCAG AA needs ~4.5:1 for normal text — white on soft pink often fails.
aria-expanded on menu toggles tells AT whether the drawer is open.
Every document needs a non-empty title — Next metadata.title is the easy fix.
Skip-to-content links are WCAG 2.4.1 — first focusable, visible on focus.
Shortest path that works first; abstractions wait for a second real caller.
Fix root cause in the shared function, not a guard in every caller.
Leave one runnable check behind non-trivial logic — future you will thank you.
Cut speculative features — YAGNI is a delivery speed multiplier.
plan → build with AI → verify → smoke → ship.
AI drafts faster when the acceptance check is already written.
Ask the model for the smallest diff that passes the failing test.
Review AI output like a junior PR — trust boundaries and a11y still need humans.
Keep prompts tied to repo patterns; re-implementing helpers wastes tokens and time.
Reproduce → isolate shared path → fix once → re-run smoke + e2e.
Flakes that vanish with retries still need a root cause before you ship.
Log the invariant you care about, not every intermediate variable.
Schedules only read the default branch — merge the workflow before you wait on cron.
Idempotent jobs: second run same day should no-op, not double-commit.
